How to Complete Meta Business Verification for WhatsApp API

Get your Business Manager verified by Meta to unlock WhatsApp Business API, remove messaging limits, and go live on Waki automatically.

⏱️ 2-5 business days•🆓 Free process•🇮🇳 India specific

Why Is Meta Business Verification Required?

📨

Remove Messaging Limits

Unverified accounts can only message test numbers. After verification, message any opted-in customer.

🟢

Sandbox → Live on Waki

Your Waki channel automatically switches from Sandbox to Live after Meta verification.

✅

Build Customer Trust

Verified businesses get a green checkmark on WhatsApp, boosting trust and open rates.

Complete Step-by-Step Process

01

Go to Meta Business Manager

Open business.facebook.com and log in with your Facebook account that owns your Business Manager.

💡 Tip: Use a desktop browser for the best experience.
02

Open Settings → Business Info

In the left sidebar click Settings, then Business Info. Scroll down to find the Business Verification section with a blue Start Verification button.

💡 Tip: If you do not see the button, you may not have admin access.
03

Enter Your Legal Business Details

Fill in your legal business name exactly as it appears on government-issued documents. Enter your registered address, business phone number, and website URL.

💡 Tip: Name must match 100% with your document — even minor differences cause rejection.
04

Choose Verification Method

Meta offers: Phone call, SMS, Email to business domain, or Document upload. For most Indian businesses, Document Upload is the most reliable.

💡 Tip: Domain email like info@yourbusiness.com is fastest if available.
05

Upload Supporting Documents

Upload 1-2 official documents: GST Certificate, Udyam/MSME Registration, Utility Bill (last 3 months), Bank Statement, or Company Registration Certificate.

💡 Tip: Upload clear, high-resolution documents in PDF or JPG format.
06

Submit Verification Request

Review all information, then click Submit. Meta will review your documents and email you the result. This typically takes 2-5 business days.

💡 Tip: Track status anytime in Settings → Business Info.
07

After Approval — Go Live on Waki

Once Meta verifies your business, your Waki channel automatically upgrades from Sandbox to Live. You can now send messages to all numbers without restrictions.

💡 Tip: Waki auto-detects verification and triggers Go Live — no manual action needed!

Accepted Documents in India

GST Certificate

Recommended

Most widely accepted — shows legal business name and address

Udyam / MSME Registration

Recommended

Government MSME portal registration certificate

Utility Bill

Common

Electricity or phone bill (within last 3 months) showing business address

Bank Statement

Common

Business bank account statement showing name and address

Company Registration

Enterprises

MCA Certificate of Incorporation for Pvt Ltd or LLP

Common Reasons for Rejection

⚠️

Business name mismatch

✅ Fix: Ensure your name in Meta matches document exactly including Pvt Ltd, LLP etc.

📍

Address mismatch

✅ Fix: The address in Meta must match the address on your document perfectly.

📄

Low-quality document

✅ Fix: Upload clear, high-resolution documents in PDF or JPG format.

🌐

Website missing business details

✅ Fix: Your website should show your business name, address, and phone number.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is Meta Business Verification free?+

Yes, completely free. There are no fees to submit documents or get verified.

How long does it take in India?+

Typically 2-5 business days. Up to 7 days in some cases.

Can I send WhatsApp messages before verification?+

Yes but limited to test numbers in Sandbox mode. After verification you can message any opted-in number.

What if my verification gets rejected?+

Meta will tell you why. Fix the issue and resubmit after 24 hours.

Does Waki help with Meta Business Verification?+

Yes! Contact our support team via chat inside your Waki dashboard for guidance.
